people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
translations.bsb: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and departed for Tirzah, and as soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
translations.kjv: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
translations.asv: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
